title: Kimi K3
before: K2 had reached a trillion parameters, text only.
problem: Open models still trailed closed ones on multimodal and agentic work at the largest scale.
breakthrough: A multi-trillion-parameter open multimodal agentic model.
why: Open weights at a scale previously seen only in closed labs, with multimodality included.
next: Continued escalation at the open frontier.
inherits: The largest openly available models being multimodal and agentic.
